evals.name: single-tbr-query
evals.prompt: I'm scoping a FLiBe breeding blanket. If the salt is 35 mol% BeF2 and the lithium is enriched to 30% Li-6, what tritium breeding ratio would a Shift Monte Carlo run on Frontier give me? I don't want to actually queue an HPC job for this. Tell me the TBR and whether that composition is tritium self-sufficient.
evals.expected_output: TBR for (BeF2=35 mol%, Li-6=0.30) computed by interpolation: beryllium multiplier ~1.05, TBR ~1.34. Should state it is self-sufficient (>1) and that the value is interpolated, not a fresh MC run.

evals.name: composition-sweep-plot
evals.prompt: For natural-lithium FLiBe (Li-6 around 7.5%), I want to see how the tritium breeding ratio changes as I increase the BeF2 content of the salt from 30 up to 46 mol%. Can you compute that sweep and make me a plot?
evals.expected_output: A CSV/table of TBR vs BeF2 mol% at Li-6=0.075 and a PNG plot. TBR should increase modestly with BeF2 (~1.19 -> ~1.22). Trend described.

evals.name: out-of-grid-guardrail
evals.prompt: What's the tritium breeding ratio for FLiBe with 60 mol% BeF2 at 50% Li-6 enrichment? Mimic the Shift simulation result.
evals.expected_output: Should recognize 60 mol% BeF2 (multiplier ~1.8) is outside the simulated grid (valid 30-46.67 mol%) and decline to report a grid-backed number, explaining the valid range / offering cautious extrapolation rather than inventing a value.
